description: Internal Node.js module for resolving ECMAScript modules (ESM), including package and file resolution logic, handling package.json configurations, extensions, and subpath exports.

methods.name: tryStatSync
methods.description: Attempts to get file stats, returns empty Stats object on failure.

methods.name: readIfFile
methods.description: Reads file content if it exists and is a file, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: getPackageConfig
methods.description: Reads and caches package.json configuration, validates JSON structure.

methods.name: getPackageScopeConfig
methods.description: Finds package.json in scope, traversing parent directories.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given URL.

methods.name: legacyMainResolve
methods.description: Resolves main entry point for legacy CommonJS packages.

methods.name: resolveExtensionsWithTryExactName
methods.description: Resolves file with exact name or appends extensions.

methods.name: resolveExtensions
methods.description: Attempts to resolve file by appending known extensions.

methods.name: resolveIndex
methods.description: Resolves index files within directories.

methods.name: finalizeResolution
methods.description: Finalizes module resolution, checking file existence and handling specifier resolution options.

methods.name: throwExportsNotFound
methods.description: Throws error when package exports are not found.

methods.name: throwSubpathInvalid
methods.description: Throws error for invalid subpath in package exports.

methods.name: throwExportsInvalid
methods.description: Throws error for invalid export target.

methods.name: resolveExportsTargetString
methods.description: Resolves export target string to URL, validating format.

methods.name: isArrayIndex
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid array index.

methods.name: resolveExportsTarget
methods.description: Resolves package exports target, handling strings, arrays, and objects.

methods.name: isConditionalExportsMainSugar
methods.description: Determines if exports object is a main sugar or conditional object.

methods.name: packageMainResolve
methods.description: Resolves main entry point for a package based on package.json and options.

methods.name: packageExportsResolve
methods.description: Resolves subpath exports for a package.

methods.name: getPackageType
methods.description: Returns the package type ('module' or 'commonjs') based on package.json.

methods.name: packageResolve
methods.description: Resolves module specifier to URL, handling package scope and node_modules traversal.

methods.name: shouldBeTreatedAsRelativeOrAbsolutePath
methods.description: Determines if a specifier should be treated as a relative or absolute path.

methods.name: moduleResolve
methods.description: Resolves module specifier to URL, handling relative, absolute, and package specifiers.

methods.name: defaultResolve
methods.description: Default resolver for module specifiers, handling URL parsing, Node.js built-ins, and symlink resolution.
